about:
ALTTRIX Corporation is based in New York, New York. The company's founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not disclosed in publicly available sources.

The firm provides artificial intelligence consulting and implementation services. Its offerings span generative AI, machine learning model development, blockchain integration, data governance, cloud solution design, and vulnerability assessment with AI-driven threat prevention. The company describes a four-step methodology: identifying business problems, gathering and analyzing data, developing appropriate AI models, and integrating and monitoring the solution. No physical facility, headcount, production volumes, or part numbers are published.

ALTTRIX serves clients across startup, fintech, education, and retail sectors, stating it works with organizations ranging from early-stage companies to the world's largest enterprises. Concrete customer names are not provided.

The company emphasizes its certified AI experts, expertise in generative AI, machine learning, and blockchain technologies, and claims a 99.9% threat prevention rate using AI predictability and probability models. Its approach is rooted in comprehensive consultations to align AI solutions with unique business needs.
